text_block_list.text:
Having finished the Japan Dirt Derby, 
Smart Falcon threw herself into the summer 
training camp with extraordinary fervor—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Nuuuuuuuuuugh~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*...! F-Fifty sprints, 
all done...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *pant*...
choice_data_list: Want to take a break soon?
Want to take a break soon?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... No! I'm still gonna keep 
going...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
After all, our upperclassmen are going to 
be running in the next JBC Classic too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco is gonna get way stronger at this 
summer camp! So, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco can still do itttt!! Please make 
Falco the top Umadol!
choice_data_list:
(Her fiery sports-anime switch has been 
flipped...)

text_block_list.text:
Still, she's under a lot of strain as it 
is. What kind of routine could she enjoy 
without overburdening herself...?
choice_data_list: Core strength! Dance lesson on the beach!
Endure! Dance Lessons at the Training Camp

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A dance lesson...! Special training for an 
Umadol!
choice_data_list: Let's train our core on the beach

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Got it! Falco is gonna dance!

Afterward, Smart Falcon continued to dance 
upon the sand. It was with a seriousness 
that completely drew in anyone watching—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... my legs... I can't lift my legs 
anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer! Falco's totally fine, 
so...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I can't just stop here... I can't afford 
to stop running...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Speed up, move faster, Falco's legs! And 
then...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Like a swan—I'll fly!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...! Did Falco just... fly?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: What's that, a musical...?

...Though she got a little too carried 
away, in the end, Smart Falcon was able to 
enjoy her training session.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A dance lesson...! Special training for an 
Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But why do I have to hold back?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, Trainer...! That's unfair, so 
unfair...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, eating that delicious-looking ramen 
all by yourself! Right in front of me! 
You're eating it!
choice_data_list: The seafood flavor is rich and delicious!
The seafood flavor is rich and delicious!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: *Gulp*...! F-Falco wants a bite, too—
choice_data_list:
Once I finish dancing through a whole 
stage... *slurp*

Once I finish dancing through a whole 
stage... *slurp*

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Trainer, you're a monster~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What's that, some kind of noble 
pastime...?

...After that, Smart Falcon pushed through 
on pure guts to dance through a whole 
stage, and I treated her to a special 
seafood ramen topped with hard clams.
